programs.title: The Admirable Crichton
programs.desc: Comedy. Kenneth More stars as the perfect butler, who assumes command when he, his aristocratic employer (Cecil Parker) and his family and friends are shipwrecked on a desert island.

programs.title: The Ghost and Mrs Muir
programs.desc: Supernatural romance starring Rex Harrison as the spirit of a gruff sea captain who haunts widow Gene Tierney, only for her to fall in love with him. Directed by Joseph L Mankiewicz.

programs.title: The Lost City
programs.desc: Comedy adventure with Sandra Bullock and Channing Tatum. When a romance novelist is kidnapped wearing a pink jumpsuit, her hapless cover model heads to the jungle to rescue her.

programs.title: Die Hard
programs.desc: Action-thriller with Bruce Willis and Alan Rickman. Can a New York cop free the hostages being held in a skyscraper by an arch villain? Yippee ki-yay... whoops, can't say that here.

programs.title: Darkman
programs.desc: Liam Neeson and Frances McDormand star in Sam Raimi's crime-fighting action-fantasy. A vengeful scientist invents a synthetic skin that lets him change his appearance..

programs.title: Gagarine
programs.desc: Uplifting French drama. A teenager sets out to fix up his run-down apartment block when it's scheduled for demolition. In French/subs. Strong language.

programs.title: Western Union
programs.desc: American frontier pioneering western starring Randolph Scott, Robert Young and Dean Jagger as three very different men working to connect east and west by telegraph in the 1860s.

programs.title: To Hell and Back
programs.desc: Fact-based wartime drama. Audie Murphy, America's most decorated soldier in WWII, plays himself in this dramatic recreation of the valiant heroics that earned him the honours.

programs.title: Inglourious Basterds Interview Special
programs.desc: The director, Quentin Tarantino, together with stars Christoph Waltz and Diane Kruger and producer Lawrence Bender, talk about the Second World War revenge adventure.

programs.title: Sign of the Pagan
programs.desc: Jack Palance plays Attila the Hun, sweeping across Europe with his hordes and conquering all before him, with Jeff Chandler as the Roman general charged with saving the Empire.
